lines.quote: Phased-array beamforming: designed and validated the digital beamformer for Sumuvire Wireless’s K-band ground-terminal receiver, a 32-element patch array with real-time null steering in azimuth and elevation, tested against measured array data.

Embedded DSP in C/C++: wrote the real-time channelisation and pulse-compression firmware for a Xilinx Zynq-based radar signal processor, meeting sub-10 µs frame-processing deadlines; maintained the codebase through three hardware revisions.
Built and maintained the signal validation toolkit (Python, ~15k LOC), a production-grade test framework used by three product teams for automated regression testing of receiver signal chains.

Performed end-to-end RF characterisation of a spaceborne L-band receiver front end for the Lumara-2 Earth observation programme: noise figure, gain flatness, and IP3 measurements using Keysight PNA-X and R&S FSW instruments in a cleanroom environment.
Performed end-to-end RF characterisation of a spaceborne L-band receiver front end for the Lumara-2 Earth observation programme
All design reviews, technical documentation, and customer deliverables at Sumuvire Wireless are conducted and written in English.
